evidence.title: Introducing Wato!
evidence.excerpt: Introducing Wato! We’re building the shared context layer for AI-enabled teams. Every team building with agents eventually hits the same wall: the work does not compound. An agent solves something useful, finds the right workflow, learns the weird caveat, builds a dashboard, or writes a playbook. Then that knowledge disappears into a chat thread, and the next agent starts from zero. Wato gives teams a shared layer for agent memory, reusable workflows, connected tools, and living artifacts like…

Wato released the biggest update to artifacts for Claude and Codex. The flow is usually: prompt -> MCPs -> data -> HTML/CSS/JS -> static dashboard Then it becomes a static HTML file, a screenshot, or a Slack link nobody trusts two weeks later. Wato makes artifacts live: permissioned, versioned, shareable, connected to data, and reusable by agents. Here's a demo below.
